args: set -euo pipefail; cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/worker/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
set -euo pipefail; test "$(cargo run -q -p tier-drop-cli -- schemas | jq 'keys | length')" = 11

evidence_required: The outputs of the S-10 checks.
The adjacent output for the README walkthrough task from the tier-3 example model at its first reasoning level.
The mutant runs that turn the adjacent_ tests red.
objective: Add the pure adjacent function to the core, the adjacent CLI command and MCP tool, the model lineage field and its value in the example registry, the skill section and the recompiled plan graph.

outputs.purpose: The pure adjacent function, its record types and its tests.
The adjacent integration test and the eleven-schema test.
The adjacent MCP tool and the thirteen-tool test.
The tool list, the schema route list and the local transcript.
A lineage on every example model.
The section "After a failure: adjacent moves".
The tool list and the CLI line.
The source list and how to recompile.

risk_controls: adjacent reuses ladder, qos_gate and the single-candidate order from crates/core instead of a second copy, so plan_next and adjacent cannot disagree about which models fit a task.
crates/core gains no std::fs, std::net, std::time or SystemTime use: adjacent reads its arguments and returns a value.
Rust only; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
Three attempts per failing gate, then stop and report.
steps: crates/core: add Model.lineage: Option<String> (#[serde(default)]); add module adjacent with ModelRef, AdjacentMoves, Move, MoveKind, PassedOver and adjacent(&ModelRef, &Task, &Registry, &[Disqualification], &Policy) -> AdjacentMoves, reusing ladder, qos_gate and the existing single-candidate ordering (no second copy of either); register adjacent_moves in schemas().

Unit tests named adjacent_* covering every observation in T-23, plus a test for each reading of the owner decision point (passed-over tiers count as one step; the alternative returns nothing), with the alternative behind a test-only flag or as a documented assertion of the current reading.
registry/registry.example.json: set lineage on every model (indicative, as of the registry date). Test fixtures for more_reasoning use a model with at least three reasoning levels (T-23).
CLI tier-drop adjacent per plan/technology-decisions.md; integration test over the example registry; update schemas_lists_ten… to eleven (rename the test).
Worker: tool adjacent with a closed inputSchema; update the tool count to thirteen in code, tests, module docs and crates/worker/README.md.
skill/SKILL.md: section "After a failure: adjacent moves" (R-07). README.md: the tool list and the CLI line.
plan/graph.json: add R-07, R-23, R-24, T-07, T-23, T-24, S-10, V-10, S-11, V-11 with their edges; recompile plan/build.json and plan/contracts/ as in S-08 and diff two compiles.
